cells.gaps: No source found says an AI tool is in service and producing outputs; the EIOS adoption is described as training.
cells.note: Rebuild 2026-11-25, read afresh: WHO says the health ministry adopted the AI-assisted EIOS surveillance tool and trained staff on it in April 2025 (COM-002), and malaria forecasting models are being built on DHIS2 data (COM-001). Neither says the tool is producing outputs, so 2.
